payload.text: 0195 (high), on vc's word of 2026-10-14 on hv's: devbin has no Homebrew formula. Building it after 0193 and ahead of 0192: a formula shaped like Utilz's that fetches the release tag by git and runs bin/devbin install --prefix libexec; a tap named like Intent's and Utilz's, built and rehearsed locally until hv decides its visibility; a release step that writes the formula's tag and commit from git; projects finding the brew install by default at Homebrew's opt/devbin path, with doctor saying which install and why; a measured url form that works while the repo is private; proof on this Mac and on kovacs, booked through vc.
